params.body:
Every source an author cites gets a page of its own on gentells.com. This PR adds the pipeline side: the list of those pages, and a page key on each citation in a post. The site side is a separate PR in gentells-site.

## Which sources get a page

- A page held under "Cited by the author" (`editorial-citations`) that a post on the site cites.
- Every source in a report's source list (`report_sources`, #448), whichever source holds the page.

The Observatory's own signals cited in a post don't get a page, so they stay behind the Sources ability on the site as before. A draft's citation doesn't get one either, and a source read for inspiration only never does.

## What is added

- **`packages/core/cited-pages.mjs`**:
  - `citedSourcePages()` returns one entry per page: key, url, publisher, title, date, unread, the posts that cite it (with the sentences it backs), the reports that cite it (with its number in the list) and the live trends it sits under. Where a report lists the source, the report's publisher, title and date come first, since that is what the reader saw in the PDF.
  - `openCitationIds()` returns the ids of the signals that count as an author's citation.
  - `pageKey()` gives the key: the first 10 hex characters of a sha256 of the signal id. It is stable, so a link printed in a PDF keeps working when a title is corrected, and it reveals nothing about the row behind it.
- **`GET /internal/projection/cited-sources`**, behind the projection token: the full set every time, like the reports, because a source stops qualifying only by its absence.
- **The article projection:** a citation in a post that has a page carries `page: <key>`.

## Merge order

Merge this first. The site's reconcile reads the new route and reports a failed section while the route is missing.

## Tests

- `test/cited-pages.test.mjs` (3):
  - which sources get a page: the Observatory signal, the draft and the inspiration source do not;
  - the fields, with the report list first and only the live trend;
  - the route, and the page key on a post's evidence.
- Full suite 1666/1666, `tsc` clean.
params.title: Cited source pages: projection of every source an author cites
